title: Generate a world with World Builder
description: Build a whole landscape from settings: landform, erosion, mountains, an ocean, biomes, trees and rocks.

steps.title: Open World Builder
steps.text: Open Window ▸ Terrain ▸ World Builder. It builds a whole landscape from a few settings.

steps.title: Create a World Builder
steps.text: Click Create World Builder. It adds a new Terrain and a World Builder object that keeps all the settings.

steps.title: Pick a landform
steps.text: Under Base Heightmap, pick a Generator, like Mountains or Islands. The Preview card at the top shows the land as you edit.

steps.title: Shape the noise
steps.text: Scale sets how big the hills are. Noise Amount and Roughness add detail. Press 🎲 Randomize for a different world.

steps.title: Erosion
steps.text: Erosion makes land look old and is on already. Hydraulic carves valleys like rain water, and Thermal lets steep slopes slide down.

steps.title: Add a mountain
steps.text: Under Stamps & Areas, click ⛰ Mountain. A mountain stamp appears in the middle of the view. Move it with the Move tool (W).

steps.title: Add an ocean
steps.text: Click 💧 Water and set its Mode to Sea Level. Everything below the Water Level turns into ocean.

steps.title: Mix biomes
steps.text: The Default Biome is Forest. Add a 🌲 Biome Zone stamp and set its Biome to Desert or Snowy Mountains.

steps.title: Textures per biome
steps.text: Under Biomes, click a biome name, like Forest. Each kind of ground (flat, slope, cliff, shore, peak) gets its own texture.

steps.title: Trees and rocks
steps.text: Scroll down to Scatter in the biome. It lists the trees and rocks and how dense they are. + Add Scatter Item adds more.

steps.title: Generate
steps.text: Click ▶ Generate. Heights, erosion, water, textures, trees and rocks are all built in one go.

steps.title: Fly around
steps.text: Hold the right mouse button in the Editor Scene and use W A S D to fly. Hold Shift to go faster. Enjoy your world!
